text:
sam_sales: Heads-up — GreenWave demo blocked: 403 on /v1/generate after rotating creds. Demo in ~15m, can someone triage? cc @alex_dev @maria_se
alex_dev: On it. Which endpoint and headers?
maria_se: Key type? org-bound/project/service?
sam_sales: They ran: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rk_live_XXXX" -H "x-redwood-org: greenwave" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'`
alex_dev: Guess: header org != token tenant. Any x-request-id or response body?
sam_sales: 403 body `{"error":"forbidden","code":"org_mismatch"}` header `x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d`. Auth logs: `2026-03-21T10:02:12Z INFO auth: token validated; tenant=gw-prod; scopes=[generate]` then `2026-03-21T10:02:12Z WARN auth: header org=greenwave != token tenant=gw-prod -> deny 403`
maria_se: Confirms it. New key bound to gw-prod while app sent greenwave. Org-bound keys cannot be overridden via header. Fixes: (1) remove `x-redwood-org` and use bound key; (2) issue tenant-agnostic demo key for header testing.
sam_sales: Customer says it worked pre-rotation. Could rotation change binding?
alex_dev: Rotation shouldn't, unless new key created under different project/account. I'll check creator.
ops_bot: key-manager: created_key rk_temp_demo_abc123 by alex_dev (expires 24h)
alex_dev: Generated a short-lived unbound demo key rk_temp_demo_abc123 for testing. Ask them to drop the org header or use this key.
sam_sales: Tried rk_temp_demo_abc123 without org header — now 429s, they fired 30 parallel requests during stress test.
maria_se: 429 = rate limit. For demos recommend concurrency <=5 and avoid big bursts. What did the response say?
sam_sales: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":2}` — they had 30 workers.
alex_dev: I can bump demo quota for rk_temp_demo_abc123 to 100rpm for 1h to unblock. Also asked them to back off.
ops_bot: quota-service: updated key rk_temp_demo_abc123 -> 100rpm (applies immediately) — change by alex_dev
sam_sales: Customer retried after 30s backoff; responses healthy. Demo resumed. :tada:
maria_se: Follow-ups: (a) trace which rotation created the org-bound key to avoid surprise, (b) add KB for sales: key types vs headers + demo checklist (concurrency, temp key flow).
sam_sales: Filing KB and linking to playbook. Thanks all! :pray:
alex_dev: I'll update demo runbook with unbound-key note and concurrency reminder.
maria_se: Marking engineering resolved. If they need sustained higher quota we can do a paid trial bump.
sam_sales: Closing loop with GreenWave now.
